evidence: src/data/ukrainian-frequency/list-audit.json (pymorphy3 / VESUM classes for every row to depth 14000)
order: explicit rows first, then the apostrophe rule, then the name rule; a merge adds the row's count to its target, a drop removes the row from the list and leaves its tokens in the coverage universe

rules.does: rewrite U+0027 and U+02BC to U+2019 in every lemma, the list's own convention (142 of its 158 apostrophe lemmas); rows that then coincide merge

a capitalized lemma tagged anything but PROPN, NOUN or ADJ is a mislabeled name or a sentence-initial common noun (Янукович ADV 94,612 tokens beside PROPN 311,542; Прес-служба ADV); its tokens join the lowercase common noun when VESUM knows that noun as a plain common noun, else the same lemma's PROPN row, else its all-caps abbreviation's PROPN row (Тасс -> ТАСС), else a PROPN row of its own

decisions.lemma: что / время / радость / словарь / из / к / с
decisions.note: Russian words from Russian-language passages, with no Ukrainian reading. Dropped as explicit ledger rows in every spelling and tag the source carries (к and с only as prepositions: the letters к and с are Ukrainian). с was added by the accuracy pass: the first review missed it because VESUM knows the letter.

decisions.lemma: дом / набор / полка / ярмарк / сусідний / Владимирський
decisions.note: Russianisms and surzhyk used in Ukrainian text. The derussification thread measures exactly these; dropping them would hide its evidence.
The UD Ukrainian convention lemmatizes немає as немати; the profiler already aliases it to мати.

decisions.decision: Луганська kept (city genitive or oblast adjective, the corpus cannot say which); Яценюкий, прес-центровий and віце-прем’єрний merged into their nouns with their sibling case forms (one, віце-прем’єра, on the v0.1.0 list itself); ла dropped
decisions.note: The віце-прем’єр-міністр family, split the same way as прем’єр-міністр, is folded under the same decision.
Names appear as PROPN and as NOUN (Янукович 311,542 / 57,635; Нью-Йорк 67,861 / 15,921). Folding them is a separate, larger change.
The source's doc_count exceeds the row's own count in 2,553 of 12,000 rows and is defined nowhere upstream, so v0.2.0 does not carry it.
